learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of the main tools of linear algebra (matrices, vector spaces, linear systems, quadratic forms) and of their applications in a geometric environment, granting both the comprehension of the connections among the different parts and the operational ability.

syllabus_topics: Diagonalization of matrices and linear maps
Euclidean scalar product. Othogonal matrices. Diagonalization of symmetric matrices.
Euclidean and affine spaces. Subspaces. Parallelism. Orthogonality.
assessment_rules: The exam consists of two compulsory written tests. Students are admitted to the second oral test after passing the first written test with at least 18/30. If a student passes the written exam, they must take the oral exam either in the same "appello" or in the following one. If a student does not pass the oral exam, they must repeat the written exam. The final grade is an overall assessment, with the written test having a decisive weight.
bibliography: Fioresi Rita, Morigi Marta, Introduzione all'algebra lineare, Edizioni CEA (2021)
institution: Università Di Bologna - Alma Mater Studiorum
